image_description: A surreal, high-fidelity digital illustration featuring a classic silver iPod Classic. The device is upright, displaying a menu screen with text. A metallic, liquid-silver humanoid figure (resembling a chrome skeleton or robot) is fused into the right side of the iPod's casing, appearing to emerge from or melt into the device. The background is plain white.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The screen is clearly visible in the upper portion of the device's front face, consistent with the iPod Classic layout.

While the left side is smooth, the right side features a complex, textured, skeletal humanoid figure, violating the 'smooth casing' description for the whole object.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The core identity of the object as an iPod with a click wheel is preserved despite the artistic modification.

artifact_observations.location: Right side of the iPod casing merging with the humanoid figure
artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic structural failure for a real-world object. The metal casing melts into a biological/mechanical hybrid figure. This is a deliberate surreal artistic choice, but represents a total deviation from the physical reality of the class label.
The text on the screen is illegible/pseudo-text. While stylized, it fails to render clear, readable characters typical of a UI.
The rigid rectangular geometry of the iPod collapses into organic shapes, defying the material properties of aluminum/plastic.
